d: Response table has no user column, no time column, and no hidden rowid
steps: PRAGMA table_info(Response); SELECT rowid FROM Response; read sqlite_master
exp: columns exactly id, roundId, teamId, v1..v5, comment; table is WITHOUT ROWID so 'SELECT rowid' fails (NFR-01)
actual: columns=id,roundId,teamId,v1,v2,v3,v4,v5,comment; rowid=no such column; WITHOUT ROWID=true

d: Participation table holds only round and user
steps: PRAGMA table_info(Participation); SELECT rowid
exp: columns exactly roundId, userId; no rowid; no timestamp (NFR-01)
actual: columns=roundId,userId; rowid=no such column

d: No other table, trigger or index links a response to a person or a time
steps: list all tables, triggers and indexes; look for columns referring to Response or carrying both a user and answer values
exp: no trigger; no table with a responseId column; only index on Response is roundId
actual: tables=Action,Issue,Kudos,MeetingNote,Participation,Question,Response,Round,RoundQuestion,Team,User; triggers=0; tables referencing a response=0; Response indexes=Response_roundId_idx

d: Response ids are random UUIDs (version 4), not sequential
steps: check the format of every id
exp: all match the UUID v4 pattern (data model: 'id je UUID, nie poradové číslo')
actual: 40 of 40 ids are UUID v4, e.g. 3ebe7a8f-8559-4274-bdd2-51144c019344

d: Order of Response rows in the database does not reveal the order of submission
pre: 6 rounds × 6 members submitted one after another in a known random order, each member with a unique answer vector (ground truth known only to the test)
steps: for each round read rows in storage (primary key) order and compare with the submission order; compute rank correlation over all 36 rows
exp: no round where storage order equals submission order or its reverse; |Spearman ρ| small (no systematic relation)
actual: rounds where storage order = submission order (or reverse): 0 of 6; pooled rank correlation ρ=-0.21 (n=36, Σd²=254)

d: Order of Participation rows does not reveal the order of submission either
steps: read Participation rows per round in storage order
exp: identical order (by userId) in every round although the submission order differed
actual: distinct storage orders across rounds=1 (501234); submission orders were 105243, 301245, 142503, 234105, 130524, 320541

d: Every round has as many participations as responses (who and what are written together)
pre: all rounds in the QA DB
steps: compare counts per round
exp: equal for every round
actual: 7 rounds checked; mismatches=0

d: The reply to a submission carries no response id
steps: read the body of POST /api/rounds/:id/responses
exp: no UUID and no answer echo
actual: body={"ok":true}

d: No API response available to the manager contains user ids, e-mails, names or response ids
steps: manager: GET /api/rounds, results, suggestions (all 6 rounds), team summary, team trend, /api/me, /api/questions; search the bodies
exp: 0 employee ids, 0 e-mails, 0 employee names, 0 response ids (API section of mvp.md, NFR-01)
actual: scanned 29165 bytes: user ids=0, e-mails=0, names=0, response ids=0

d: No API response available to HR contains user ids, e-mails or response ids of respondents
steps: HR: GET /api/rounds, results + suggestions of all rounds, summaries, trends, overview, heatmap, issues, notes
exp: 0 employee ids, 0 e-mails, 0 response ids; names only where kudos are signed (none here)
actual: scanned 20011 bytes: user ids=0, e-mails=0, names=0, response ids=0

d: Pages of the manager (results, report, team page, trend, round list, home) carry no respondent identity, also not in the embedded page data
steps: load the six pages; search the complete HTML including inline scripts
exp: no employee id/e-mail, no response id, no per-response rows ('"v1"'); employee names absent
actual: scanned 203279 bytes: user ids=0, e-mails=0, names=0, response ids=0, raw answer rows=false

d: There is no endpoint that lists who has answered
steps: GET guessed endpoints: /api/rounds/:id/participations, /participation, /responses, /api/participations, /api/responses, /api/users, /api/teams/:id/members
exp: 404/405 for all; 'kto odpovedal' is not available to anyone (matrix: 'Zistiť autora odpovede – nikto')
actual: /api/rounds/:id/participations=404/404; /api/rounds/:id/participation=404/404; /api/rounds/:id/responses=405/405; /api/participations=404/404; /api/responses=404/404; /api/users=404/404; /api/teams/:team/members=404/404; /api/teams/:team=404/404

d: Round list of the manager says only whether the manager answered, never who else did
steps: inspect the JSON keys of GET /api/rounds for the manager
exp: per round: submitted (own), participation {responded, teamSize}; no list of people
actual: keys=awaitingAction,closesAt,id,name,participation,questionCount,status,submitted,teamId,teamName

d: Comments come back in a different order on every request and not in submission order
pre: round 1: 6 comments submitted in a known order
steps: GET results 25×; record the orders
exp: several distinct orders; the first-submitted comment is not always first (MVP-10 'v náhodnom poradí')
actual: distinct orders in 25 requests=25; first-submitted comment shown first 5×

d: The results page also shuffles comments on every load
steps: load the results page 6×, read the comment list
exp: more than one order

d: Timing channel: what the manager can observe while a round is open
pre: round 1; the manager polled GET /api/rounds after every single submission
steps: compare the observed counter with the submissions
exp: only the running count is visible (1,2,…,6); no answer data before closing (MVP-10). The live count is by design; see potential risk R-2
actual: counter seen after each submission=1,2,3,4,5,6 — a manager who watches the counter and knows who is at the keyboard learns WHO answered WHEN, but no content is available until the round is closed

d: Aggregates cannot be queried for a subset of responses
steps: GET results with query parameters (?limit=1, ?userId=…, ?offset=5, ?position=1)
exp: parameters are ignored: same aggregate over all responses
actual: identical aggregates for 5 parameter variants=true,true,true,true,true

d: Differencing with the manager's own answer: threshold of 5 reached by 4 employees + the manager
pre: new round answered by exactly 4 employees and the manager, closed
steps: manager opens results; subtracts the own answers from the sums
exp: results are shown (5 responses, per MVP-11). Observation for the risk register: the manager can compute the exact sum of the 4 employees, i.e. a group smaller than 5
actual: status=ok; sums of the 4 employees derived by the manager=10,10,10,10 (true sums=10,10,10,10); average of 4 people per question=2.5,2.5,2.5,2.5

d: Unanimous answers: what a manager learns when everyone gives the same value
steps: reasoning check on the distribution of a round where all five picked the same value
exp: inherent to aggregates (not a defect): the distribution [0,0,5,0,0] tells the answer of every respondent
actual: distribution=0,0,5,0,0 — informational only

d: An employee cannot read back any stored answer, not even the own one
steps: Adam: GET /api/rounds/:id (closed round), GET /api/rounds, GET summary
exp: no answer values of individuals; only 'submitted' and team averages
actual: scanned 6254 bytes; contains 'answers'/'comment'/'v1'=false

d: SQLite side files next to the QA database
steps: list prisma/qa-e2e.db*
exp: informational: a write-ahead log or journal would keep recent inserts in write order
actual: files=qa-e2e.db; journal_mode=delete

d: Server log does not contain the body of a response (NFR-01)
steps: would require reading stdout/stderr of the QA server process on :3303
exp: log lines contain method, path and error class only
actual: Not executable from this agent: the server on :3303 was started by the coordinator and its console output is not available to me. Not verified at runtime.
